snippet.title: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart | Announcement Trailer Summer Games Fest - Day of the Devs
snippet.description:
KARTING EVOLVED.

🏁 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348210/Super_YookaLaylee_Kart/

Super Yooka-Laylee Kart is a skilful, expressive and explosive arcade racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks.

Officially revealed during Summer Game Fest as part of Day of the Devs, Super Yooka-Laylee Kart sees Yooka and Laylee ditching platforms for tracks across worlds old and new in a precision-focused kart racer built for fierce competition, tactical comebacks, and endless rematches.

Race through a deep Story Campaign, compete online, dominate the sofa with up to 8-player local split-screen, or create your own custom races, rules and rivalries.

Master advanced techniques, weapons, tactical perks, and devastating Rage abilities as you fight for every position in high-stakes arcade racing where every drift matters.

FEATURES

• Precision-focused arcade racing built around mastery and high-skill manoeuvres
• Unique Rage system that rewards tactical comebacks and brutal payback
• Create your own races, rules and rivalries
• Deep Story Campaign packed with tournaments, challenges and rival races
• Online multiplayer, Time Trials and leaderboards
• Up to 8-player local split-screen multiplayer
• Vibrant pixel art combined with modern rendering techniques

Follow Playtonic for future updates, multiplayer beta tests, and more.

#SummerGameFest #DayOfTheDevs #SuperYookaLayleeKart #YookaLaylee
